name: Rafael Souza
bio:
Rafael's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching Ayrton Senna dominate the tracks. He channeled this enthusiasm into mastering the art of automotive painting and finishing. After completing a specialized apprenticeship in São Paulo, he honed his skills at a local custom car shop, where he developed a keen eye for detail and a dedication to achieving flawless results.

Joining ROWE Racing was a dream come true for Rafael. He takes immense pride in his role, understanding that a perfectly executed paint job is not just about aesthetics, but also about contributing to the team's overall performance through weight reduction and aerodynamic efficiency. His colleagues appreciate his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality. Rafael's loyalty and willingness to mentor junior team members have made him an invaluable asset to the team, always striving for perfection in every coat.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting his years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always wears a pair of noise-cancelling headphones, even when not actively painting.
Has a small collection of miniature racing helmets displayed on his workbench.
Obsessively cleans his spray guns after each use, regardless of how busy he is.
